records.name: Mercy-Douglass Corporation
records.notes: Affordable housing owner and manager for seniors and people with disabilities. Residents apply for an apartment. The site lists no volunteer, member or community program, so it is treated as a building operator rather than a group. No dated news found. Reconsider if the owner wants housing providers listed. Batch website was given as mercydouglass.org and was read over https.

records.name: Mill Creek Community Partnership
records.summary: Neighbors working to strengthen the Mill Creek area of West Philadelphia through free art and education programs, community events, and voter information.
records.what_you_do: Come to a free art class, workshop, or community event, or send the partner and volunteer form on the site to ask how to help.

schedule.text: Free events and workshops are announced on the website; no regular weekly schedule was listed.

cost.text: Most programs and events are free

first_step.how: Fill out the partner or volunteer inquiry form on mccpcommunity.com, or email mccpcommunity@gmail.com to ask about the next free event
first_step.basis: Free public events are listed and there is a clear way to get in touch, but no open calendar with dates was posted.

records.notes: Batch name matches the IRS legal name. The only dates on the site are historical (founded 2005, and a 2022 and a 2024 primary campaign by the contact, Cass Green, as written on the site). The footer year is a typo and is not used. Flagged for owner review: the site mentions the contact's campaign runs, though its listed programs are arts, education, community events and voter education. The gala is sold on Eventbrite, which was not read. No street address is published on the site, so the IRS address (4234 Ogden St, 19104) is not recorded as a location.

records.name: Mom Your Business
records.summary: A nonprofit that helps Black and Brown women start and grow businesses in the Philadelphia region, with office hours, skill-building, and help getting funding.
records.what_you_do: Book an office hour for one-on-one business help, take part in networking and skill-building events, or use the FounderyPHL map of local business resources, which is open to anyone in the region.

schedule.text: Office hours by sign-up through the website contact page; no regular weekly schedule was published.

first_step.how: Sign up for office hours through the contact page on momyourbusiness.com
first_step.basis: The way in is clear, but the main pathway is for Black and Brown women founders and the site does not say whether office hours are open to others.

records.notes: IRS address is 4024 Aspen St, 19104. The site lists 348 E Walnut Lane, #4, and that address is recorded. Community is set to women because the main pathway is for Black and Brown women founders; the FounderyPHL map is open to anyone in the region. The only year on the site is a 2026 copyright footer, which is not used as evidence. The site's events page returned a 404. Status rests on the site being live with no dated items. Program cost is not stated.

records.name: Motivated Community Resource Center
records.summary: A West Philadelphia community center for families and youth. It runs a free homeschool support program, a food pantry that runs every other Saturday, and health and wellness workshops.
records.what_you_do: Volunteer on the food pantry day, sign up for the free homeschool support program, or come to a community workshop.

schedule.text: Food pantry (called The Free Market) every other Saturday, 11 a.m. to 1 p.m., as listed on the site. The listing is undated.

cost.text: Homeschool support is free to register for. Pantry cost is not stated.

first_step.how: Use the Volunteering page on motivatedcrc.org, or fill out the homeschool interest form on the same site
first_step.basis: The site gives a clear way to volunteer or register and serves families in West Philadelphia, but the last dated item is from 2024.

records.notes: Batch name Motivated Young Scholars is the homeschool support program this center runs at the same address, so the record uses the center's everyday name. Status is dormant by the 24 month rule: the newest dated item on the site is a guest comment from May 04, 2024. The site still describes a pantry every other Saturday, but without a date. The events page returned a 404. A 2026 image file name on the site is a flyer name and is not used as evidence. The phone number is listed on the site's donate line. Confirm the pantry still runs before showing this group as active.

records.name: Philadelphia Film Factory
records.summary: A film education group for local independent filmmakers. It offers classes and workshops on making films, writing scripts, and acting on camera, plus a free youth filmmaking program for teens.
records.what_you_do: Take a beginner class such as Intro to Filmmaking or Intro to Screenwriting, come to a networking event, or ask about the Take One program for teens.

schedule.text: 2026 classes and workshops are listed on the site. Check the class list for dates and times.

cost.text: Class fees are not listed in the text read. The Take One youth program is described as free.

first_step.how: Browse the 2026 class list on philmfactory.org, sign up for the newsletter, or email info@philmfactory.org to ask about the Take One program for teens
first_step.basis: Introductory classes are listed for beginners and the site says how to sign up.

records.notes: Two posts dated March 13, 2026 on the site: a Nu Millennium Multimedia Studios open house and an Entrepreneur Works event with producer Julius Tennon. The Take One program is described as free on a donation link. Actors Intensive is listed as 18 and over. The site also lists a guest speaker address on a different domain; it is not recorded here.

records.name: Philadelphia Rebelz Basketball
records.summary: A North Philadelphia basketball program for young players. It fields teams, runs coaching, hosts clinics and tournaments, and gives away gear to the community.
records.what_you_do: Register for a team or a community event such as the 3v3 tournament, or come to a gear giveaway. Some events are 18 and over or invitation only.

schedule.text: Teams, clinics and tournaments are posted on the site when announced. No regular weekly schedule was published.

first_step.how: Use the Register Now form on rebelz.club to sign up for a team or an event
first_step.basis: The register form is public, but the site does not say who may join, whether teams hold tryouts, or what they cost, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: The only year-level dates are a 2025 footer copyright (not used) and an event named UnityKlassic 2025, listed as 18 and over and invitation only. No full date is written, so status is probably_active for a working site. The events page returned a 404. No street address is published on the site. The IRS address is 4025 Green St, 19104, and is not recorded as a location because the site does not confirm it. Coaching profiles mention ages 9 to 18 for coaching experience, not as an eligibility rule.

records.name: Project MEOW
records.summary: An all-volunteer cat rescue in West Philadelphia. It trap, neuters and returns community cats, cares for kittens and sick cats, and fosters and adopts out friendly cats.
records.what_you_do: Volunteer, foster a cat or kitten, help a community cat caretaker, or adopt from the adoptable cats listed on the site.

first_step.how: Use the Volunteer with us link on projectmeow.org, or fill out the Volunteer Application on the site
first_step.basis: The volunteer page and application are public and no membership or dues are needed. The site lists no orientation dates.

records.notes: The heading CATS HELPED In 2026 is the newest year on the site, but it has no month and the figures read 1, which may be placeholders, so it is not counted as a dated item. The footer copyright 2025 is not used. The site gives no street address; the IRS address is 801 S 48th St, 19143, and is not recorded. No phone or email was shown on the page read.

records.name: Promise Zone Research Connection
records.summary: Connects West Philadelphia residents with researchers in the Promise Zone, so neighbors can help shape and review community research.
records.what_you_do: Join as a resident member, share a research project with the Community Research Review Board, or come to a research event.

first_step.how: Email info@pzrc.org and ask how to join as a resident member or attend the next community event
first_step.basis: An email address is published, but the site does not explain membership and lists no current event, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: Newest dated item is a participatory research event on December 13, 2023. The events page says there are no upcoming events; the earlier listed meeting was February 9, 2022. The homepage 2026 copyright is not used. The Research Day photo is undated. Kind network is a best fit, not a self-description. Status is dormant by the 24 month rule, so the owner may want to review before showing it as active.

records.name: Retired Tails
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that rescues senior dogs from local shelters, finds them permanent homes, and fosters other animals in volunteers' homes.
records.what_you_do: Adopt a senior dog from the Adopt-a-Pet profiles, foster or help out from home, come to an adoption or community event, or support the group through its help and donation pages.

first_step.how: Browse the Adopt-a-Pet profiles on retiredtails.org, or email Wagmessages@retiredtails.org to ask about fostering or volunteering
first_step.basis: Adoption profiles and events are public and need no membership. The physical location is not open yet, and volunteer details were not listed.

records.notes: Newest dated item is a Wine Wall fundraiser listed as Summer 2024, with no month. A February to March Sojo Spa raffle has no year and is not used. Status is dormant by the 24 month rule. The site's mailto link points to Retiredtails@yahoo.com, which differs from the Wagmessages address recorded; confirm which is current. The physical location at 1026 S 52nd Street is under construction and not open to visitors, so it is not recorded as a location.

records.name: Simply Music
records.summary: A Philadelphia music nonprofit for children and teens. It offers in-person and online music classes, plus recitals, workshops and student CD releases.
records.what_you_do: Take a music class in person on a Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon, or online. Ask the studio how to enroll, and come to workshops and recitals.

schedule.text: In-person classes on Tuesday and Wednesday, 12 to 7 pm, as listed on the site. Event months are listed but no full dates are written.

first_step.how: Use the contact form on simplymusicinc.com, or call (267) 701-2359, to ask about enrolling in a Tuesday or Wednesday class
first_step.basis: Classes and recitals are listed, but the site does not explain how to sign up, what classes cost, or who they are for, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: The founding year, 2008, is from the homepage. The events page lists months only (June Black Music Month, July guest speakers, October recital) and no full dates, so there is no dated evidence and status is probably_active for a working site. The fundraisers and newsletter pages are linked but were not read. The IRS address is 6109 Washington Ave, 19143; the site does not confirm it as the class location, so it is not recorded. Cost is not stated.

notes: Verdicts: 13 publish, 2 not_a_group. Two IRS groups had a name in the website field (Philadelphia Artists in Residence and Reach Community Impact) and each got its one WebSearch; neither search found a matching organization, so both are unverified records held for a manual check. Muslims 4 Humanity's domain did not resolve and no search was left, so it was not checked. Public Trust returned empty pages twice. Dormant by the 24 month rule: Motivated Community Resource Center (newest dated item May 2024), Promise Zone Research Connection (December 2023) and Retired Tails (Summer 2024). The owner may want to review these before they show as active. Event-page 404s: momyourbusiness.com/events, motivatedcrc.org/events, rebelz.club/events. Budget: 2 of 2 WebSearch calls used; 20 fetches used. Process note: I made one call to a Claude Docs guide tool by mistake. It returned only a menu, created nothing, and was not used again.
